customManagers.description: Versions pinned on the line after a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment (dx CLI, gitleaks) in CI, the README and the Dockerfile. rust-toolchain.toml is handled by the built-in manager. `semver` versioning because these are exact pins: with the crate datasource's default `cargo` versioning, `0.7.9` would be read as the range `^0.7.9` and never bumped

packageRules.description: Group minor updates to limit PR noise. They wait for the maintainer.
Group patch updates and automerge them once the required CI checks pass.
The dioxus crates and the dx CLI (dioxus-cli, pinned in CI, README and Dockerfile) must always move together, in one PR. Never automerged, even for patches: Dioxus bumps always get a review.

sqlx is held on 0.8: tower-sessions-sqlx-store (Postgres sessions) depends on sqlx 0.8 and must share the app's PgPool. The sqlx crates and sqlx-cli (pinned in CI and the README) move together. Lift the cap once the store supports a newer sqlx.
